title: Case 029: Is the new device linked?
initial_request: I started registering a new tablet for H&V mobile banking, but I am not sure the process finished. Please tell me whether the device is linked and whether it can be used for banking operations.
overview: Mara Ellison escalated case HV-029 after starting registration of a new tablet in the H&V app and being unsure whether it had completed. The agent checked the device-linking state in the access log and the secure portal showed that confirmation is still pending.

next_action.summary: Check the device-linking state in the access log.

outcome: The device-linking stage is known: it is awaiting confirmation. The device has not yet been admitted for banking operations.

events.body: I started registering my new tablet in the H&V app while setting it up. I left the screen before I could tell whether registration had finished.
I’m following up because I need to know whether this tablet is linked before I try to use it for banking. Could you check its current status?
I’m checking the device-linking state for Mara Ellison’s new tablet under case HV-029. Please return the recorded status only.
Device status: Awaiting confirmation. This tablet has not yet been admitted for banking operations.
